# AcqPath Rights Preflight

Timestamped diagnostic reports of observed RSL declarations. Reports are not licenses or legal clearance.

- [Contract](https://api.getacqpath.com/openapi.json)
- [Current coverage and prices](https://api.getacqpath.com/v1/capabilities)
- [Public site](https://getacqpath.com)
- [MCP transport](https://api.getacqpath.com/mcp): quote preparation; paid report delivery uses HTTP x402.

Do not send credentials in prompts. No claim of universal MCP payment compatibility, arbitrary-web coverage, provider routing or automatic license acquisition.
